title: GTA 6 players found 44 secrets already 👀 #gta6 #shorts
description: Players reported 44 easter eggs within the first hours, including a possible Michael De Santa boat reference (VGTimes, Quero Bolsa).

scenes.say: Players found forty four GTA 6 secrets within hours.

scenes.label: Easter eggs found
scenes.say: Forty four easter eggs, all over Leonida, before most people finished the first mission.
One of them looks like a boat matching the one Michael owns in GTA 5.
Rockstar always hides callbacks to older games.
Found any yourself? Tell me where.
